method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.behavior: Script-side reference-counted perk check (function(str_perk), bool): if isdefined( self.var_fb3c9d6a ) && isdefined( self.var_fb3c9d6a[ str_perk ] ) && self.var_fb3c9d6a[ str_perk ] > 0, explicitly return true; otherwise explicitly return false. NOTE: only the script-side counter; the ENGINE perk set is a separate mechanism (callers also use the hasperk builtin directly, e.g. power_gain_event_score in packet notes).
unknowns: Divergence between script counter and engine perk set is observable only at callers outside this file

summary.behavior: Reference-counted perk unsetter (function(str_perk)) on a player/script entity. 1) if !isdefined( self.var_fb3c9d6a ) -> self.var_fb3c9d6a = [] (count map init; field resolved exactly from source). 2) if !isdefined( self.var_fb3c9d6a[ str_perk ] ) -> entry = 0. 3) self.var_fb3c9d6a[ str_perk ]-- (decrement). 4) assert( self.var_fb3c9d6a[ str_perk ] >= 0, "<dev string:x38>" ) (dev-only assertion text as printed). 5) if self.var_fb3c9d6a[ str_perk ] <= 0 -> self unsetperk( str_perk ) (engine builtin removal, no namespace = builtin). Companion setter perk_setperk and perk_reset_all are excluded units in this file (not re-authored); this function only decrements and removes at zero.
unknowns: var_fb3c9d6a consumers outside this file (perk_setperk increments it) are excluded units/unassigned
unsetperk engine-side removal effects (stat recomputation) not in packet
